text: わたしと　ポケモン　したいの？

structure.jp: ポケモン　したいの？

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'. したい = 'want to do'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice asks for the story behind what the speaker sees; the だ is left off. したいの？ = 'is it that you want to?'
